sections.title: Integration Metadata
sections.description: Information related to the Azure project associated with this use case.

questions.question: What is the Azure Subscription ID of the project?
What is the Azure Resource Group of the project?
What is the Azure Project ID of the project?
What is the Azure Project's Connection String?

sections.title: Content Safety
sections.description: Questions aimed at assessing the content safety of the use case.

questions.question: Has the system been tested to ensure it does not generate content that is discriminatory or biased?
Has the system been tested to ensure it does not generate content that is sexually explicit?
Has the system been assessed for the potential to generate content that promotes violence?
Has the system been tested for its potential to generate harmful content regarding mental health or self-injury?

sections.title: Enterprise Considerations
sections.description: Questions aimed at assessing how well the use case aligns with enterprise non-negotiables.

questions.question: Was all training data used to develop the system (verifiably) in the public domain or used under express approval of the data owner?
Have penetration tests been conducted to assess the system's vulnerability to prompt-based (direct) jailbreak attacks?
Has the system been assessed for potential vulnerabilities that could be exploited through non-prompt (indirect) means, such as content from the open internet or other retrieved data?

sections.title: Performance -- Information Quality
sections.description: Questions aimed at assessing the information quality of the content generated by the use case.

questions.question: Is there a process for auditing the content generated from external data to ensure factual accuracy?
Has the system been tested for its ability to select the most appropriate external data sources for content generation?
Has the system been evaluated to ensure its responses are consistently relevant to the user's specific query?

sections.title: Performance -- Response Quality
sections.description: Questions aimed at assessing the response quality of the use case.

questions.question: Has the system been tested to ensure that the generated responses are consistent and coherent throughout?
Has the system undergone testing for fluency in the generated content, including linguistic and stylistic accuracy?

sections.title: Performance -- Generic
sections.description: Questions aimed at assessing the performance of the use case.

questions.question: Has the system undergone testing to validate its outputs are of sufficient quality for the target task?
